have h1 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have h2 : 2 ∣ n ∨ 2 ∣ n + 1 ∨ 2 ∣ n + 2 := by
    rw [Nat.even_iff]
    exact Nat.even_three_consec_integers n
  cases h2 with h2a h2b h2c
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right 2 n) (dvd_mul_left 2 (n + 1) (n + 2))
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_left 2 n) (dvd_mul_right 2 (n + 2))
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right 2 (n + 1)) (dvd_mul_left 2 n (n + 2))
have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have h4 : 3 ∣ n ∨ 3 ∣ n + 1 ∨ 3 ∣ n + 2 := by
    rw [Nat.divisible_iff]
    exact Nat.three_dvd_one_of_three_consec_integers n
  cases h4 with h4a h4b h4c
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right 3 n) (dvd_mul_left 3 (n + 1) (n + 2))
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_left 3 n) (dvd_mul_right 3 (n + 2))
  · exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right 3 (n + 1)) (dvd_mul_left 3 n (n + 2))
have h5 : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
  dvd_mul_of_dvd_left_and_dvd_right 2 3 h1 h3
